current_task_corrections.correction: Change the financial_summary component's statistics parameter from 'sum_mean' to 'sum_mean_quantiles' to report median, p90, and p99 percentiles alongside sums and means for paid_amount and other amount columns, fully capturing the distribution of skewed financial data.

reusable_lessons.lesson: When computing a denial rate or similar rate metric, use only adjudicated claims (claim_status in {Paid, Denied, Adjusted}) as the denominator, excluding Pended claims which are not yet decided. Always record both the numerator and denominator definitions and the denominator_option parameter.

When computing monthly trends of claims activity, key the trend on service_date_from (when care occurred) rather than adjudication_date (when claims were processed), as adjudication dates lag service and can introduce inconsistencies in historical trend analysis.
